Europe, meet your new CFO 💶

Today, Perplexity launches Personal CFO in Europe, powered by Plaid. People in 17 countries can now connect their bank accounts and ask about their money.

This is the new bar. People expect this kind of personalization from every financial app they use, and we’re proud to power it on a global scale.

More here: pla.id/perplexityEU
